verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports non-interactive scripting and GitHub Actions integration (@gemini-cli mentions for PR reviews, issue triage, on-demand assistance) which can run tasks in a cloud CI environment, and Cloud Shell offers a ready cloud runtime — but there's no dedicated 'run this long task in an isolated background cloud sandbox' feature akin to a hosted agent service. missing for 10: explicit isolated cloud sandbox/background execution product, evidence of long-running autonomous task delegation outside CI triggers, and independent confirmation it works reliably for extended background jobs.
